children: Kelly Michelle White disclosed a 16.9% stake in Rainmaker Worldwide Inc.'s common stock. On Sep. 21, 2026, she and 2752128 Ontario Ltd. filed a Schedule 13D that details transactions dating back to January 2025. The position includes shares owned directly plus stock issuable from a convertible note and an option, making her a significant holder.

White holds the shares for investment and as compensation for services. She wrote that "The securities were acquired as compensation for services, through conversion or restructuring of amounts owed for services previously rendered, and for investment purposes." This stake reflects direct ownership and the right to receive additional shares upon conversion of a December 31, 2025 note and the exercise of an option. The filing lays out a clear picture of how the position grew through service compensation, note conversions, and option grants, rather than through a cash market accumulation.

She may buy or sell more shares, convert the note, or exercise options in the future. She also stated, "Except as described in this Schedule 13D, the Reporting Persons do not currently have any plans or proposals that relate to or would result in any of the matters described in Item 4(a) through (j)." In short, she signals flexibility to adjust the position but does not outline plans to seek control, board changes, or other corporate actions at this time.

Kelly Michelle White is a Canadian finance and accounting consultant who serves as President and sole director of 2752128 Ontario Ltd. Through 2752128 Ontario Ltd., she provides finance and accounting consulting services, including past work for Rainmaker Worldwide Inc. She controls all voting and investment decisions for securities held by 2752128 Ontario Ltd.
